name: Cisco Meraki
description: Cloud-managed networking platform. Monitor network infrastructure and device access.

config.setupInstructions:
1. Log in to the Meraki Dashboard at https://dashboard.meraki.com
2. Click your profile icon (top right) > My profile
3. Scroll to API access and click Generate new API key
4. Copy the key (shown once) and paste it above
5. Ensure your dashboard user has access to the organizations you want to monitor

Note: Treat the API key like a password. Meraki uses the X-Cisco-Meraki-API-Key header for authentication.
